rules.statement: The Court of Requests has jurisdiction to hear and determine an action for the recovery of possession of immovable property, including claims for arrears of rent up to Rs. 750 in value, without being ousted by the inclusion of such a claim.
rules.supporting_quote: "Since the test of jurisdiction is the value of the right of possession, the claim for arrears of rent should be regarded as incidental and subsidiary and its inclusion cannot oust the jurisdiction of the Court so long as the amount claimed at the date of action does not exceed Rs. 750."
